fields.value:
The Data Report EEG document contains general information about the contents of the files.
The “Data” folder contains two documents (a file and a folder):
• [2019.98_Ethical clearance_Da Silva_Wandering Minds…_30 Sept 2019.pdf ] : ethical clearance form
• [test data], which contains
1. [PPN…set]: raw data (structure)from all participants
2. [PPN…fdt]: raw data from all participants (without the structure)
3. [preprocessing.m]: code for preprocessing the data with information about channels and events
4. [montage32_1.xyz]: file imported by [preprocessing.m] file with channel labels/ locations
